scope: Full read-only source and existing-receipt review. No remote call, helper import, Cargo, native test, model or Clippy execution; no repository source changes.
verdict: No blocking issue found in the frozen prepared runner. Actual launch and qualification results are separate.
source_chain_review: The same-Q MoQ receipt must have terminal phase, an actual integer exit, intact complete source map, head/tree/status, containment/log integrity and before/after file identities. Every started process must have a retained original exit and successful owned-group cleanup.

The actual C3 reference.json schema and its six preceding stage names and phases were read. C3 source0cc, raw identity, native process count/cleanup and original comparison failure remain separate from Q. The exact six original receipt files are rehashed against the already admitted C3 record.
Original default and strict gate bytes were independently rehashed and parsed: both original exit101 remain historical evidence. Their source0cc is not presented as Q workspace execution.
Whole Q Git changed-path list and two reviewed source bytes were checked through local immutable Git objects, in addition to checking contract JSON values.

command_environment.limit: Exact recorded overrides and the existing whitelist are compared; this is not a proof about an unrecorded complete historical environment.
command_environment.tool_identity: Four official ready.json executable identities are required; rustdoc/clippy-driver, selected compilers, Python, Git and the runner/helper are also observed before and after.

ownership_and_failure_review.ordinary_formatter_failure: Each of two leaf format checks retains its original nonzero result; the one unchanged strict Clippy command may still run, and the overall result remains nonzero.
ownership_and_failure_review.unsafe_phase: Launch exception, timeout, signal exit, unresolved containment or raw-log integrity stops new qualification phase admission. Source/script/tool identity failures produce integrity125.
ownership_and_failure_review.exit_accounting: Original pre-cleanup and final process exit, phase exit, containment/log-integrity exit, wrapper exit and overall result remain separate. first_failed_phase and last_failed_phase preserve distinct failures.
ownership_and_failure_review.cleanup: Only newly owned process groups may receive TERM2s and KILL1s. The recorded actual leader reap and non-atomic final group absence do not claim all descendants were individually joined.
ownership_and_failure_review.final_checks: Whole-source snapshot, head/tree/status, every observed file and elapsed budget are checked before final exit; the elapsed budget is checked again after result persistence.

independent_ast_verification.run_owned_change: Removed the unused repeat-round branch and adapted scope wording; launch/owned-group/timeout/raw-log lifecycle was read in full.
independent_ast_verification.stopped_phase_change: Stores first and last failed phase independently.

observed_limit: This is static review of an authorized bounded launcher. It is not a Clippy pass, a Q full-workspace runtime gate, a model inference, or production HMI qualification.
